title: ‘Are You Dead’ app – level 1
paragraphs: In China, many people use a phone app. The app helps them feel safe.
The app asks one question each day. The question is: “Are you dead?” People tap the phone to say that they are okay. If they do not tap for two days, the app sends a message to family or friends.

Many people in China live alone now. Fewer people marry. Older people often live without their children. Sometimes, people from work know more about a person than their family. Older people worry about getting help.
People talk less face-to-face. But phones are not the same as real people. People are online all the time, but they feel lonely. You need to be with others to feel good and healthy.
